import json,re
from itertools import combinations
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('anonymous_traces.jsonl',encoding='utf-8') if s.strip()]
texts=list(dict.fromkeys(str(r.get('input','')) for r in rows))
marker=re.compile(r'(?<"'!'"\\w)(?:\\[["'^'"\\]\\r\\n]{1,48}\\]|<["'^>'"\\r\\n]{1,48}>)')
directive=re.compile(r'\\b(format|output|answer|respond|return|exact|json|serialize|delimiter|separated|must|should|between)\\b',re.I)
line_only=paired_markup=0
for text in texts:
 lines=text.splitlines()
 a=any(directive.search(line) and len(line.strip())<=700 for line in lines)
 b=any(len(marker.findall(line))>=2 and len(line)<=1600 for line in lines)
 line_only+=a
 paired_markup+=a or b
print('pooled_unique_inputs',len(texts),'directive_line_variant',line_only,'directive_plus_markup_variant',paired_markup)
# Compare exact common-line removal on varied pooled pairs; no correctness or task grouping.
def residual(a,b):
 left,right=a.splitlines(),b.splitlines(); i=j=removed=0
 limit=.55*min(len(a),len(b))
 while i<len(left) and j<len(right) and left[i].strip()==right[j].strip():
  n=max(len(left[i]),len(right[j]))+1
  if removed+n>limit: break
  removed+=n; i+=1; j+=1
 return removed,i,len(left)-i,len(right)-j
best=(0,None)
for ai,bi in combinations(range(min(len(texts),80)),2):
 shared,n,la,lb=residual(texts[ai],texts[bi])
 if n>best[0]: best=(n,(ai,bi,shared,la,lb))
print('shared_prefix_variant_best_pair',best[1])
for wins,losses in [(0,0),(3,0),(0,3)]:
 rel=(wins+1)/(wins+losses+2)
 print('feedback_factor',wins,losses,round(.75+.5*rel,3))
'@ | python -"

import json
from itertools import combinations
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('anonymous_traces.jsonl',encoding='utf-8') if s.strip()]
texts=list(dict.fromkeys(str(r.get('input','')) for r in rows))
def shared_counts(a,b,with_suffix):
 left,right=a.splitlines(),b.splitlines(); i=j=removed=0; lim=.55*min(len(a),len(b))
 while i<len(left) and j<len(right) and left[i].strip()==right[j].strip():
  size=max(len(left[i]),len(right[j]))+1
  if removed+size>lim: break
  removed+=size; i+=1; j+=1
 prefix=i; li,ri=len(left),len(right); suffix=0
 if with_suffix:
  while li>i and ri>j and left[li-1].strip()==right[ri-1].strip():
   size=max(len(left[li-1]),len(right[ri-1]))+1
   if removed+size>lim: break
   removed+=size; li-=1; ri-=1; suffix+=1
 return prefix,suffix,removed
best_prefix=(0,None); best_both=(0,None); any_suffix=0
for ai,bi in combinations(range(len(texts)),2):
 p,s,c=shared_counts(texts[ai],texts[bi],True)
 if p>best_prefix[0]: best_prefix=(p,(s,c))
 if p+s>best_both[0]: best_both=(p+s,(p,s,c))
 any_suffix+=bool(s)
print('unique_pair_count',len(texts)*(len(texts)-1)//2)
print('best_exact_prefix_lines_and_chars',best_prefix)
print('best_prefix_plus_suffix_lines',best_both)
print('pairs_with_shared_suffix_lines',any_suffix)
'@ | python -"
